text: An existing Python application's Nagini proof runs as the same explicit Docker user as its commands (#416, #418). Its verifier input sits in a directory private to the gate's user, and Nagini's container drops every capability, so on Linux its root couldn't read the input. The first real Python run in CI failed every proof the same way: mypy couldn't read the input. The receipt's recorded Nagini command leaves the identity out, as it does the host's directory, so receipts stay the same on every host.
